refined_interpretation: p = 'pause' (pausieren). AXM-enriched main-loop MARKING atom. Upgraded PLAUSIBLE -> SOLID. p is the single most MARKING-dominant atom in the system (12.033x, 93.63%), with the strongest carryover of any atom (8.126x), and compositional convergence across 3/4 compounds. p creates a MARKING pause that resets at line boundaries (cross-line 0.000x) and operates proactively (ACTOR timing 26.7%). The op=TRANSITION gateway (95.5% INITIAL) functions as a process restart: o(arrange)+p(pause) = transition point. p dominates category in ALL p-containing compounds (cp, pc, ep all = MARKING), which is why order sensitivity fails -- p's MARKING signal is too strong for the second atom to override. German: pausieren (to pause). Consistent with REGIME 2 context: 'seal->heat->PAUSE->cool overnight->unseal->collect'.
